t: This is the home of Somewhere On Earth, a podcast about technology around the world. It's a radio-style programme rather than a building you can wander around, so think of this spot as its base. It was founded by Ania J Lichtarowicz, a journalist and radio producer, and that background shows in the format: global stories told for the ear. I don't have more detail than that, so I'll leave it there. It's best experienced by listening, perhaps on your headphones while you're nearby.
